1.1: Beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim veal hakkilayim. bachamishsha asar bo korin et hammegilla bakkerakkin, umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet mikveot hammayim, veosin kol tzarche harabbim, umetzayyenin et hakkevarot, veyotzin af al hakkilayim:
1.2: Amar rabbi yehuda, barishona hayu okrin umashlichin lifnehem. mishsherabbu ovre avera, hayu okrin umashlichin al hadderachim, hitkinu sheyyehu mafkirin kol hassade kullah:
1.3: Bachamishsha asar bo, shulchanot hayu yoshvin bammedina. beesrim vachamishsha, yashvu bammikdash. mishsheyyashvu bammikdash, hitchilu lemashken. et mi memashkenin, leviyyim veyisreelim, gerim vaavadim meshuchrarim, aval lo nashim vaavadim uketannim. kol katan shehitchil aviv lishkol al yado, shuv eno posek. veen memashkenin et hakkohanim mippene darke shalom:
1.4: Amar rabbi yehuda, heid ben bucheri beyavne, kol kohen sheshshokel eno chote. amar lo rabban yochanan ben zakkay, lo ki, ella kol kohen sheeno shokel chote, ella shehakkohanim dorshim mikra ze leatzman, (Vayikra 6) vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel, hoil veomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim shellanu, heach neechalim:
1.5: Af al pi sheamru, en memashkenin nashim vaavadim uketannim, im shaklu mekabbelin miyyadan. hannachri vehakkuti sheshshaklu, en mekabbelin miyyadan. veen mekabbelin miyyadan kinne zavin vekinne zavot vekinne yoldot, vechataot vaashamot. (aval) nedarim unedavot, mekabbelin miyyadan. ze hakkelal, kol shenniddar veniddav, mekabbelin miyyadan. kol sheen niddar veniddav en mekabbelin miyyadan. vechen hu meforash al yede ezra, shenneemar (ezra 4) lo lachem velanu livnot bayit lelohenu:
1.6: Veellu shechayyavin bakkalbon, leviyyim veyisreelim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarim, aval lo kohanim venashim vaavadim uketannim. hashshokel al yede kohen, al yede ishsha, al yede eved, al yede katan, patur. veim shakal al yado veal yad chavero, chayyav bekalbon echad. rabbi meir omer, shene kalbonot. hannoten sela venotel shekel, chayyav shene kalbonot:
1.7: Hashshokel al yede ani, veal yede shecheno, veal yede ben iro, fatur. veim hilvam chayyav. haachin vehashshuttafin shechayyavin bakkalbon, peturin mimmaaser behema. ucheshechayyavin bemasar behema, peturin min hakkalbon. vechamma hu kalbon, maa kesef, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, chetzi:

2.1: Metzarfin shekalim ledarkonot mippene massoy hadderech. keshem shehayu shofarot bammikdash, kach hayu shofarot bammedina. bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen venignevu o sheavadu, im nitrema hatteruma, nishbain laggizbarim. veim lav nishbain livne hair, uvene hair shoklin tachtehen. nimtzau, o shehechezirum haggannavim, ellu vaellu shekalim, veen olin lahen leshana habbaa:
2.2: Hannoten shiklo lachavero lishkol al yado, ushekalo al yede atzmo, im nitrema teruma maal. hashshokel shiklo mimmeot hekdesh, im nitrema teruma vekarva habbehema maal. middeme maaser sheni, middeme sheviit, yochal kenegdan:
2.3: Hamechannes maot veamar, hare ellu leshikli, bet shammay omrim, motaran nedava. uvet hillel omrim, motaran chullin. sheavi mehen leshikli, shavin shemmotaran chullin. ellu lechatat, shavin shehammotar nedava. sheavi mehen lechatat, shavin shehammotar chullin:
2.4: Amar rabbi shimon, ma ben shekalim lechatat. shekalim yesh lahem kitzva, vechatat en lah kitzva. rabbi yehuda omer, af lishkalim en lahen kitzva, shekkeshealu yisrael min haggola hayu shoklim darkonot, chazru lishkol selaim, chazru lishkol tevain, uvikkeshu lishkol dinarim. amar rabbi shimon, af al pi chen, yad kullan shava. aval chatat, ze mevi besela veze mevi bishtayim veze mevi beshalosh:
2.5: Motar shekalim, chullin. motar asirit haefa, motar kinne zavin, kinne zavot, kinne yoldot, vechataot vaashamot, motrehen nedava. ze hakkelal, kol shehu ba leshem chatat uleshem ashma, motaran nedava. motar ola, laola. motar mincha, lammincha. motar shelamim, lashshelamim. motar pesach, lashshelamim. motar nezirim, lannezirim. motar nazir, lannedava. motar aniyyim, laaniyyim. motar ani, leoto ani. motar shevuyim, lashshevuyim. motar shavuy, leoto shavuy. motar hammetim, lammetim. motar hammet, leyorshav. rabbi meir omer, motar hammet, yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. rabbi natan omer, motar hammet bonin lo nefesh al kivro:

3.1: Bishlosha perakim bashshana, tormin et hallishka, bifros happesach, bifros atzeret, bifros hechag, vehen geranot lemasar behema, divre rabbi akiva. ben azzay omer, beesrim vetisha baadar, uveechad besivan, uveesrim vetisha beav. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim, beechad benisan, beechad besivan, beesrim vetisha beelul. mippene ma amru beesrim vetisha beelul, velo amru beechad betishre, mippene shehu yom tov, vei efshar leasser beyom tov, lefichach hikdimuhu leesrim vetisha beelul:
3.2: Beshalosh kuppot shel shalosh shalosh sein tormin et hallishka, vechatuv bahen alef vet giml. rabbi yishmael omer, yevanit katuv bahen alf vet gaml. en hattorem nichnas lo befargod chafut, velo beminal, velo besandal, velo bitfillin, velo bekamia, shemma yaani, veyomru meavon hallishka heeni, o shemma yaashir, veyomru mitterumat hallishka heeshir. lefi sheadam tzarich latzet yede habberiyyot kederech shetztzarich latzet yede hammakom, shenneemar (Bamidbar 32) vihyitem nekiyim meAdonai umiyyisrael, veomer (Mishlei 3) umetza chen vesechel tov beene elohim veadam:
3.3: Shel bet rabban gamliel (haya) nichnas veshiklo ben etzbeotav, vezorko lifne hattorem, vehattorem mitkavven vedochako lakkuppa. en hattorem torem ad sheyyomar lahem, etrom. vehen omrim lo, terom, terom, terom, shalosh peamim:
3.4: Taram et harishona umechappe biktavlaot, sheniyya umechappe biktavlaot. shelishit lo haya mechappe, shemma yishkach veyitrom min haddavar hattarum. taram et harishona leshem eretz yisrael, usheniyya leshum kerachin hammukkafin lah, vehashshelishit leshum bavel uleshum maday uleshum medinot harchokot:

4.1: Hatteruma me hayu osin bah, lokchin bah temidin umusafin veniskehem, haomer ushete hallechem velechem happanim, vechol karbenot hatztzibbur. shomre sefichim bashsheviit, notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. rabbi yose omer, (af harotze) mitnaddev shomer chinnam. amru lo, af atta omer, sheenan bain ella mishshel tzibbur:
4.2: Para vesair hammishtalleach velashon shel zehorit, bain mitterumat halishka. kevesh para, vechevesh sair hammishtalleach velashon shebben karnav, veammat hammayim, vechomat hair umigdeloteha, vechol tzarche hair, bain mishsheyare hallishka. abba shaul omer, kevesh para kohanim gedolim osin oto mishshel atzman:
4.3: Motar sheyare hallishka me hayu osin bahen, lokchin bahen yenot, shemanim uselatot, vehassachar lahekdesh, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, en mistakkerin mishshel hekdesh velo mishshel aniyyim:
4.4: Motar teruma me hayu osin bah, rikkue zahav tzippuy levet kadshe hakkodashim. rabbi yishmael omer, motar happerot lekayitz hammizbeach, umotar hatteruma lichle sharet. rabbi akiva omer, motar hatteruma lekayitz hammizbeach, umotar nesachim lichle sharet. rabbi chananya segan hakkohanim omer, motar nesachim lekayitz hammizbeach, umotar hatteruma lichle sharet. ze vaze lo hayu modim bapperot:
4.5: Motar hakketoret me hayu osin bah, mafrishin (mimmenna) sechar haummanin, umechallelin otah al sechar haummanin, venotnin otah laummanin bischaran, vechozrin velokchin otah mitteruma chadasha. im ba hechadash bizmanno, lokchin otah mitteruma chadasha. veim lav min hayyeshana:
4.6: Hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen devarim reuyin lekarbenot hatztzibbur, yinnatnu laummanin bischaran, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo ben azay, enah hi hammidda, ella mafrishin mehen sechar haummanin, umechallelin otan al maot haummanin, venotnin otan laummanin bischaran, vechozrin velokchin otan mitteruma chadasha:
4.7: Hammakdish nechasav vehayta bahen behema reuya legabbe hammizbeach, zecharim unekevot, rabbi eliezer omer, zecharim yimmachru letzarche olot, unekevot yimmachru letzarche zivche shelamim, udemehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit. rabbi yehoshua omer, zecharim atzman yikkarvu olot, unekevot yimmachru letzarche zivche shelamim, veyavi bidmehen olot, ushear nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit. rabbi akiva omer, roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer middivre rabbi yehoshua, sherabbi eliezer hishva et middato, verabbi yehoshua chalak. amar rabbi pappeyas, shamati kedivre shenehen, shehammakdish beferush, kedivre rabbi eliezer. vehammakdish setam, kedivre rabbi yehoshua:
4.8: Hammakdish nechasim vehayu bahen devarim reuyin al gabbe hammizbeach, yenot, shemanim veofot, rabbi elazar omer, yimmachru letzarche oto hammin veyavi bidmehen olot, ushear nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit:
4.9: Achat lishloshim yom, meshaarin et hallishka. kol hamekabbel alav lesappek selatot mearba, amdu mishshalosh, yesappek mearba. mishshalosh veamdu mearba, yesappek mearba, sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona. veim hitlia solet, hitlia lo. veim hechmitz yayin, hechmitz lo. veeno mekabbel et meotav, ad sheyyehe hammizbeach meratztze:

5.1: Ellu hen hamemunnin shehayu bammikdash, yochanan ben pinchas al hachotamot, achiyya al hannesachim, mattitya ben shemuel al happeyasot, petachya al hakkinnin. petachya, ze mardechay. lamma nikra shemo petachya. shehaya poteach bidvarim vedorshan, veyodea shivim lashon. ben achiyya al chole meayim, nechuneya chofer shichin, gevine charoz, ben gever al neilat shearim, ben bevay al happakia, ben arza al hatztziltzal, hugras ben levi al hashshir, bet garmu al maase lechem happanim, bet avtinas al maase hakketoret, elazar al happarochot, ufinchas al hammalbush:
5.2: En pochatin mishshelosha gizbarin umishshiva amarkalin, veen osin serara al hatztzibbur bemamon pachut mishshenayim, chutz mibben achiyya sheal chole meayim veelazar sheal happarochot, sheotan kibbelu rov hatztzibbur alehen:
5.3: Arbaa chotamot hayu bammikdash, vechatuv alehen, egel, zachar, gedi, chote. ben azzay omer, chamishsha hayu, vaaramit katuv alehen, egel, zachar, gedi, chote dal, vechote ashir. egel meshammesh im niske bakar gedolim uketannim, zecharim unekevot. gedi meshammesh im niske tzon gedolim uketannim, zecharim unekevot, chutz mishshel elim. zachar meshammesh im niske elim bilvad. chote meshammesh im niske shalosh behemot shel metzorain:
5.4: Mi shehu mevakkesh nesachim holech lo etzel yochanan shehu memunne al hachotamot, noten lo maot umekabbel mimmennu chotam. ba lo etzel achiyya shehu memunne al hannesachim, venoten lo chotam umekabbel mimmennu nesachim. velaerev bain ze etzel ze, vaachiyya motzi et hachotamot umekabbel kenegdan maot. veim hotiru hotiru lahekdesh. veim pachatu, haya meshallem yochanan mibbeto, sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona:
5.5: Mi sheavad mimmennu chotamo, mamtinin lo ad haerev. im motzin lo kede chotamo, notnin lo. veim lav lo haya lo. veshem hayyom katuv alehen mippene harammain:
5.6: Shete leshachot hayu bammikdash, achat lishkat chashaim, veachat lishkat hakkelim, lishkat chashaim yire chet notnim letocha bachashay, vaaniyyim bene tovim mitparnesim mitochah bachashay. lishkat hakkelim, kol mi shehu mitnaddev keli, zorko letochah. veachat lishloshim yom, gizbarin potchin otah. vechol keli shemmotzin bo tzorech levedek habbayit, mannichin oto. vehashshear nimkarin bidmehen venoflin lelishkat bedek habbayit:

6.1: Shelosha asar shofarot, shelosha asar shulchanot, shelosh esre hishtachavayot, hayu bamikdash. shel bet rabban gamliel veshel bet rabbi chananya segan hakkohanim hayu mishtachavin arba esre. vehechan hayta yetera, keneged dir haetzim, shekken masoret beyadam meavotehem sheshsham haaron nignaz:
6.2: Maase bechohen echad shehaya mitassek, veraa haritzpa shehi meshunna mechaveroteha. ba veamar lachavero. lo hispik ligmor et haddavar ad sheyyatzta nishmato, veyadu veyichud sheshsham haaron nignaz:
6.3: Vehechan hayu mishtachavim, arba batztzafon, vearba baddarom, shalosh bammizrach, ushetayim bammaarav, keneged shelosha asar shearim. shearim deromiyyim semuchin lammaarav, shaar haelyon, shaar haddelek, shaar habbechorot, shaar hammayim. velamma nikra shemo shaar hammayim, shebbo machnisin tzelochit shel mayim shel nissuch bechag. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, bo hammayim mefakkim vaatidin lihyot yotzin mittachat miftan habbayit. leummatan batztzafon semuchin lammaarav, shaar yechanya, shaar karban, shaar nashim, shaar hashshir. velamma nikra shemo shaar yechanya, shebbo yatza yechanya begaluto. bammizrach, shaar nikanor, ushene fishpeshin hayu lo, echad bimino veechad bismolo. ushenayim bammaarav shello haya lahem shem:
6.4: Shelosha asar shulchanot hayu bammikdash, shemone shel shayish bevet hammitbechayim, shealehen medichin et hakkeravayim. ushenayim bemaarav hakkevesh, echad shel shayish veechad shel kesef al shel shayish hayu notnim et haevarim, al shel kesef kele sharet. ushenayim baulam mibbifnim al petach habbayit, echad shel shayish veechad shel zahav, al shel shayish notnin lechem happanim bichnisato, veal shel zahav bitziato, shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. veechad shel zahav mibbifnim, shealav lechem happanim tamid:
6.5: Shelosha asar shofarot hayu bammikdash, vechatuv alehem, tiklin chadtin vetiklin attikin, kinnin vegozle ola, etzim, ulevona, zahav lakkapporet. shishsha, lindava. tiklin chadtin, shebbechol shana veshana. attikin, mi shello shakal eshtakad, shokel leshana habbaa. kinnin, hem torim. vegozle ola, hen bene yona. vechullan olot, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, kinnin, echad chatat veechad ola. vegozle ola, kullan olot:
6.6: Haomer, hare alay etzim, lo yifchot mishshene gizrin. levona, lo yifchot mikkometz. zahav, lo yifchot middinar zahav, shishsha lindava, nedava me hayu osin bah, lokchin bah olot, habbasar lashshem, vehaorot lakkohanim. ze midrash darash yehoyada kohen gadol, (Vayikra 5) asham hu ashom asham laAdonai. (ze hakkelal), kol shehu ba mishshum chet umishshum ashma, yillakach bo olot, habbasar lashshem, vehaorot lakkohanim. nimtzeu shene ketuvim kayyamim, asham laAdonai, veasham lakkohanim, veomer, (Melachim b 12), kesef asham vechesef chataot lo yuva bet Adonai lakkohanim yihyu:

7.1: Maot shennimtzeu ben hashshekalim lindava, karov lashshekalim yippelu lashshekalim, lannedava yippelu lannedava, mechetza lemechetza yippelu lannedava. ben etzim lilvona, karov laetzim yippelu laetzim, lallevona yippelu lallevona, mechetza lemechetza yippelu lallevona. ben kinnin legozle ola, karov lakkinnin yippelu lakkinnin. legozle ola yippelu legozle ola, mechetza lemechetza yippelu legozle ola. ben chullin lemaaser sheni, karov lachullin yippelu lachullin, lemaaser sheni yippelu lemaaser sheni, mechetza lemechetza yippelu lemaaser sheni. ze hakkelal, holchim achar hakkarov (lehakel). mechetza lemechetza lehachemir:
7.2: Maot shennimtzeu lifne sochare behema, leolam maaser. behar habbayit, chullin. birushalayim bishat haregel, maaser. uvishar kol yemot hashshana, chullin:
7.3: Basar shennimtza baazara, evarim, olot. vachatichot, chataot. birushalayim, zivche shelamim. ze vaze teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa. nimtza baggevulin, evarim, nevelot. chatichot, muttarot. uvishat haregel shehabbasar merubbe, af evarim muttarin:
7.4: Behema shennimtzet mirushalayim vead migdal eder, uchemiddatah lechol ruach, zecharim, olot. nekevot, zivche shelamim. rabbi yehuda omer, harauy lifsachim, pesachim kodem laregel sheloshim yom:
7.5: Barishona hayu memashkenin et motzeha, ad shehu mevi nesacheha. chazru lihyot mannichin otah uvorchin. hitkinu bet din sheyyehu nesacheha bain mishshel tzibbur:
7.6: Amar rabbi shimon, shiva devarim hitkinu bet din, veze echad mehen, nachri sheshshillach olato mimmedinat hayyam veshillach immah nesachim, kerevin mishello. veim lav, kerevin mishshel tzibbur. vechen ger shemmet vehinniach zevachim, im yesh lo nesachim, kerevin mishshello. veim lav, kerevin mishshel tzibbur. utenay bet din hu al kohen gadol shemmet, shettehe minchato kereva mishshel tzibbur. rabbi yehuda omer, mishshel yorshin. ushelema hayta kereva:
7.7: Al hammelach veal haetzim sheyyihyu hakkohanim neotim bahen, veal happara shello yehu moalin beefrah, veal hakkinnin happesulot sheyyehu vaot mishshel tzibbur. rabbi yose omer, hamesappek et hakkinnin, mesappek et happesulot:

8.1: Kol harukkin hannimtzaim birushalayim tehorin, chutz mishshel shuk haelyon, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, bishar yemot hashshana, shebbaemtza temein veshebbatztzedadin tehorin. uvishat haregel, shebbaemtza tehorin veshebbatztzedadin temein, shemmippene shehen muatin mistallekin latztzedadin:
8.2: Kol hakkelim hannimtzain birushalayim derech yerida levet hatevila temein. derech aliyya, tehorin, shello kederech yeridatan aliyyatan, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, kullan tehorin, chutz min hassal vehammagrefa vehammeritztza hameyuchadin lakkevarot:
8.3: Sakkin shennimtzet bearbaa asar, shochet bah miyyad. bishlosha asar, shone umatbil. vekofitz, ben baze uven baze shone umatbil. chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat, shochet bah miyyad. bachamishsha asar, shochet bah miyyad. nimtzet keshura lesakkin, hare zo kassakkin:
8.4: Parochet shennitmet bivlad hatuma, matbilin otah bifnim umachnisin otah miyyad. veet shennitmet beav hatuma, matbilin otah bachutz veshotchin otah bachel. veim hayta chadasha, shotchin otah al gag haitztabba, kede sheyyiru haam et melachtah shehi naa:
8.5: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan, parochet avyah tefach, veal shivim ushetayim nimin neereget, veal kol nima venima esrim vearbaa chutin. arkah arbaim amma verachbah esrim amma, umishshemonim ushete ribbo naaset. ushetayim osin bechol shana, ushelosh meot kohanim matbilin otah:
8.6: Besar kadshe kadashim shennitma, ben beav hatuma, ben bivlad hatuma, ben bifnim, ben bachutz, bet shammay omrim, hakkol yissaref bifnim, chutz mishshennitma beav hatuma bachutz. uvet hillel omrim, hakkol yissaref bachutz, chutz mishshennitma bivlad hatuma bifnim:
8.7: Rabbi eliezer omer, et shennitma beav hatuma, ben bifnim ben bachutz, yissaref bachutz. veet shennitma bivlad hatuma, ben bifnim ben bachutz, yissaref bifnim. rabbi akiva omer, mekom tumato sham serefato:
8.8: Evare hattamid, nittanin mechatzi kevesh ulemata bammizrach, veshel musafin nittanin mechatzi kevesh ulemata bammaarav, veshel rashe chodashim nittanin mittachat karkov hammizbeach millemata, hashshekalim vehabbikkurim en nohagin ella bifne habbayit, aval masar dagan umasar behema vehabbechorot nohagin ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit. hammakdish shekalim uvikkurim, hare ze kodesh. rabbi shimon omer, haomer bikkurim kodesh, enan kodesh:
